title: The role of escape clauses: Firm response to thin capitalization rules
title_zh: 逃逸条款的作用：企业应对资本弱化规则的反应
title_primary: 逃逸条款的作用：企业应对资本弱化规则的反应
title_secondary: The role of escape clauses: Firm response to thin capitalization rules
authors: Martin E. Andresen, Lars Thorvaldsen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Multinational firms can use internal debt to shift taxable income across jurisdictions. To limit such profit shifting and protect the corporate tax base, many countries use thin capitalization rules that restrict interest deductibility. These rules often include escape clauses that exempt firms below specified thresholds, but such thresholds may create incentives for avoidance within corporate groups. This paper evaluates Norway’s 2014 thin capitalization rule using difference-in-differences, bunching, and regression discontinuity designs. We find that exposed firms sharply reduce leverage after the reform, driven by lower intra-group borrowing and interest costs, with no detectable effects on firm performance. At the corporate-group level, leverage remains unchanged, indicating that firm-level responses primarily reflect intra-group debt reallocation. We document substantial bunching below the rule’s exemption thresholds, especially among newly created subsidiaries, and show that internal debt is disproportionately shifted to these bunching firms. Although firms eliminate most of their initial exposure to the rule itself, this happens largely through reduced internal lending, and we find suggestive evidence of higher taxable income in the medium run. Because we observe only the Norwegian parts of multinational groups, we cannot provide conclusive evidence on cross-border profit shifting. Overall, the findings show that firm-level escape clauses generate strategic avoidance responses within corporate groups, while also suggesting that the reform may have protected the Norwegian tax base.
abstract_zh: 跨国公司可利用内部债务在不同司法管辖区之间转移应税收入。为限制此类利润转移并保护企业所得税税基，许多国家采用资本弱化规则以限制利息扣除。这些规则通常包含豁免条款，对低于特定门槛的企业予以豁免，但此类门槛可能在企业集团内部诱发规避动机。本文利用双重差分法、聚束分析和断点回归设计评估挪威2014年资本弱化规则的效果。研究发现，受影响的公司在改革后显著降低杠杆率，这一变化主要由集团内部借款及利息支出的减少所驱动，且未对公司绩效产生可检测的影响。在企业集团层面，杠杆率保持不变，表明公司层面的反应主要反映集团内部债务的重新配置。我们记录了规则豁免门槛下方显著的聚束现象，尤其是在新设立的子公司中，并证明内部债务不成比例地转移至这些聚束企业。尽管企业基本消除了其对规则本身的初始敞口，但这主要通过减少内部借贷实现，且我们发现有提示性证据表明中期应税收入有所增加。由于我们仅能观察到跨国集团在挪威境内的部分，无法就跨境利润转移提供结论性证据。总体而言，研究结果表明，公司层面的豁免条款在企业集团内部引发策略性规避行为，同时亦提示该改革可能对挪威税基起到了保护作用。

title: Market power, growth, and wealth inequality
title_zh: 市场势力、增长与财富不平等
title_primary: 市场势力、增长与财富不平等
title_secondary: Market power, growth, and wealth inequality
authors: Giammario Impullitti, Pontus Rendahl
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In recent decades, the U.S. economy has experienced a rise in market power, a slowdown in productivity growth, and a pronounced increase in wealth concentration. We develop a theory in which a decline in competition jointly generates these developments. Reduced competition raises markups and firm valuations while weakening knowledge spillovers and slowing growth. Higher firm valuations put upward pressure on the return gap, (r-g), while slower growth allows the real interest rate to fall. The wider return gap changes saving behavior across the wealth distribution, increasing wealth concentration. To study this mechanism, we combine an endogenous-growth model with heterogeneous households and incomplete markets. Quantitatively, the model accounts for substantial parts of the observed rise in markups and wealth concentration and the decline in productivity growth, while also generating a fall in the real interest rate. Changes in saving behavior among the top 1 percent explain almost the entire rise in concentration. Finally, higher market power lowers welfare for most households while benefiting only the very top of the wealth distribution.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，美国经济经历了市场力量的增强、生产率增长的放缓以及财富集中度的显著上升。我们构建了一个理论，其中竞争减弱共同引发了这些发展。竞争减少提高了加成率和企业估值，同时削弱了知识溢出并减缓了增长。更高的企业估值对回报率差距（r-g）形成上行压力，而增长放缓则使实际利率得以下降。更宽的回报率差距改变了财富分布中的储蓄行为，加剧了财富集中。为研究这一机制，我们将内生增长模型与异质性家庭及不完全市场相结合。在定量上，该模型解释了观察到的加成率上升、财富集中度增加以及生产率增长下降的相当大部分，同时也能生成实际利率的下降。前1%人群储蓄行为的变化几乎解释了集中度上升的全部原因。最后，更高的市场力量降低了大多数家庭的福利，而仅惠及财富分布最顶端的群体。

title: Do Local Synthetic Opioid Overdose Deaths Affect Provider Prescribing of Buprenorphine?
title_zh: 地方合成阿片类药物过量死亡是否影响医生丁丙诺啡处方行为？
title_primary: 地方合成阿片类药物过量死亡是否影响医生丁丙诺啡处方行为？
title_secondary: Do Local Synthetic Opioid Overdose Deaths Affect Provider Prescribing of Buprenorphine?
authors: Nicole Siegal, Sumedha Gupta, Matthew C. Aalsma, Stephen Crystal, Jennifer Miles 等
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Buprenorphine prescribing for opioid use disorder remains far below the scale of the overdose crisis. We estimate the causal effect of county-level synthetic opioid overdose mortality shocks on the volume of buprenorphine treatment delivered, exploiting the staggered geographic diffusion of synthetic opioids from 2013 to 2023. Linking IQVIA Longitudinal Prescription Claims to National Vital Statistics System mortality records, we implement a difference-in-differences estimator with propensity score matching under three complementary exposure measures. Treatment volume increases significantly under all three definitions, with no evidence of differential pre-trends; point estimates for buprenorphine prescribing rates range from 5 to 17 percent of pre-treatment means, emerge within one to two quarters, and grow monotonically thereafter. Our design does not separately identify changes in patient demand and provider behavior, but the increase in unique prescribers is consistent with a provider-side response. The response is concentrated among advanced practice providers, Medicaid patients, and counties with pre-existing buprenorphine infrastructure; counties with little baseline prescribing show no response. Local mortality information acts as a determinant of treatment volume, with effects comparable in magnitude to major legislative interventions aimed at expanding treatment, but appear only where prescribing capacity already exists.
abstract_zh: 阿片类药物使用障碍的丁丙诺啡处方量仍远低于药物过量危机的规模。我们估算了县级合成阿片类药物过量死亡率冲击对丁丙诺啡治疗量的因果效应，利用2013年至2023年合成阿片类药物在地理上的交错扩散。将IQVIA纵向处方索赔数据与国家生命统计系统死亡率记录相链接，我们在三种互补暴露度量下实施带有倾向得分匹配的双重差分估计。在三种定义下，治疗量均显著增加，且无差异化前趋势的证据；丁丙诺啡处方率的点估计值介于治疗前均值的5%至17%之间，在一至两个季度内显现，此后单调增长。我们的设计无法分别识别患者需求与提供者行为的变化，但独特处方提供者数量的增加与供给侧响应一致。该响应集中于高级执业提供者、医疗补助患者以及已有丁丙诺啡基础设施的县；基线处方量较低的县未显示响应。地方死亡率信息作为治疗量的决定因素，其效应在量级上与旨在扩大治疗的主要立法干预相当，但仅在已有处方能力的地区显现。

title: The Superstar Buyer Penalty during Financial Crises: Evidence from Firm-to-Firm Trade Data
title_zh: 金融危机期间超级明星买家的惩罚：来自企业间贸易数据的证据
title_primary: 金融危机期间超级明星买家的惩罚：来自企业间贸易数据的证据
title_secondary: The Superstar Buyer Penalty during Financial Crises: Evidence from Firm-to-Firm Trade Data
authors: Sergi Basco, Ludovic Panon, Enrico Sette
official: 官方在线 2026-06-11 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper documents that firms connected with superstar buyers experience larger real losses when hit by financial shocks. Using Italian loan-level data, we show that firms most affected by the credit crunch induced by the 2011 sovereign debt crisis reduced exports more sharply. Importantly, export declines were larger for exporters connected with foreign superstar buyers prior to the shock. This amplification is explained by superstar buyers disproportionately reallocating purchases away from exposed suppliers, which also experienced lower sales and employment. Partial-equilibrium aggregation implies that this superstar penalty explains around one-third of the aggregate negative effect of the credit supply shock.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了与超级明星买家有关联的企业在遭受金融冲击时面临更大的实际损失。利用意大利贷款层面的数据，我们表明，受2011年主权债务危机引发的信贷紧缩影响最严重的企业，其出口下降更为剧烈。重要的是，对于在冲击前与外国超级明星买家有关联的出口商而言，出口下降幅度更大。这种放大效应可归因于超级明星买家不成比例地将采购从受冲击供应商处转移，这些供应商还经历了较低的销售额和就业。局部均衡加总表明，这种超级明星惩罚解释了信贷供给冲击总体负面效应的约三分之一。

title: The Political Economy of Public Debt: A Laboratory Study
title_zh: 公共债务的政治经济学：一项实验室研究
title_primary: 公共债务的政治经济学：一项实验室研究
title_secondary: The Political Economy of Public Debt: A Laboratory Study
authors: Marco Battaglini, Salvatore Nunnari, Thomas R Palfrey, Luiz de Mello, Joao Tovar Jalles 等
official: 官方在线 2018-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper reports the results from a laboratory experiment designed to study political distortions in the accumulation of public debt. A legislature bargains over the levels of a public good and of district specific transfers in two periods. The legislature can issue or purchase risk-free bonds in the first period and the level of public debt creates a dynamic linkage across policymaking periods. In line with the theoretical predictions, we find that public policies are inefficient and efficiency is increasing in the size of the majority requirement, with higher investment in public goods and lower debt associated with larger majority requirements. Debt is lower when the probability of a negative shock to the economy in the second period is higher indicating that even in a political equilibrium debt is used to smooth consumption and to insure against political uncertainty. Finally, also in line with the theoretical predictions, we find that dynamic distortions are eliminated independently of the voting rule when the first period majority can commit to a policy for the second period. The experiment however highlights two phenomena that are surprising in terms of standard theory and have not been previously documented. First, balancing the budget in each period is a focal point, leading to lower distortions than predicted. Second, higher majority requirements induce significant delays in reaching an agreement.
abstract_zh: 本文报告了一项实验室实验的结果，旨在研究公共债务积累中的政治扭曲现象。立法机构在两个时期内就公共产品水平和地区特定转移支付进行谈判。立法机构可以在第一期发行或购买无风险债券，公共债务水平在政策制定期间形成了动态联系。与理论预测一致，我们发现公共政策效率低下，且效率随多数要求规模的增大而提高，即更大的多数要求与更高的公共产品投资和更低的债务相关联。当第二期经济遭受负面冲击的概率较高时，债务水平较低，这表明即使在政治均衡中，债务也被用于平滑消费和防范政治不确定性。最后，同样与理论预测相符，我们发现当第一期的多数派能够对第二期的政策做出承诺时，无论投票规则如何，动态扭曲都会被消除。然而，实验揭示了两个在标准理论视角下令人意外且此前未被记录的现象。首先，每期预算平衡成为一个焦点，导致扭曲程度低于预测。其次，更高的多数要求会导致达成协议的显著延迟。

title: Deferred training
title_zh: 延迟培训
title_primary: 延迟培训
title_secondary: Deferred training
authors: Michael Waldman, Zhenda Yin
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Standard human-capital theory predicts that firms invest in training early in a worker’s tenure to maximize the duration of returns. Yet in practice, training is often deferred to later stages of employment. This paper develops a unifying framework for understanding deferred training. We begin by establishing a benchmark result: in standard dynamic environments, firm-sponsored training is front-loaded. We then extend the framework to identify three conceptually distinct forces that can generate deferral: (1) productive efficiency, where training is delayed because later investment yields higher returns; (2) turnover management, where firms postpone training to mitigate mobility risk; and (3) poaching deterrence, where firms suppress early training to conceal information about worker ability. While the first mechanism is efficiency enhancing, the latter two reflect timing distortions. For each mechanism, we characterize the underlying logic, derive testable predictions, and draw implications for firm practice and public policy that promote timely skill development.
abstract_zh: 标准人力资本理论预测，企业会在员工任职初期进行培训投资，以最大化回报期限。然而，实践中培训往往被推迟到雇佣关系的后期阶段。本文构建了一个统一框架来理解延迟培训现象。我们首先确立一个基准结果：在标准动态环境中，企业资助的培训倾向于前置。随后，我们扩展该框架，识别出三种概念上不同的力量可能产生延迟：（1）生产效率，即培训因后期投资带来更高回报而被推迟；（2）流动管理，即企业通过推迟培训来降低流动性风险；（3）挖角威慑，即企业抑制早期培训以隐藏关于员工能力的信息。第一种机制提升效率，而后两种则反映了时间上的扭曲。针对每种机制，我们刻画其内在逻辑，推导可检验的预测，并为促进及时技能发展的企业实践与公共政策提出启示。

title: Does social media exacerbate political polarization? Experimental evidence from varying access to Twitter/X during a presidential debate
title_zh: 社交媒体是否加剧了政治极化？——来自总统辩论期间不同Twitter/X访问权限的实验证据
title_primary: 社交媒体是否加剧了政治极化？——来自总统辩论期间不同Twitter/X访问权限的实验证据
title_secondary: Does social media exacerbate political polarization? Experimental evidence from varying access to Twitter/X during a presidential debate
authors: Rafael Di Tella, Ramiro H. Gálvez, Ernesto Schargrodsky
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study how variation in social media access (Twitter/X) during a salient political event affects political polarization and stress, and how these exposure effects relate to broader patterns of selection into social media. We conducted a pre-registered laboratory experiment during the 2019 Argentine presidential debate, recruiting both Twitter users and non-users. Twitter users were randomly assigned to one of four conditions: watching the debate with their usual phone access, watching the debate with their phones switched off, watching the debate while interacting with an experimenter-run Twitter account that shared a balanced mix of partisan content, or watching a politically neutral documentary without phones. Non-Twitter participants were randomly assigned to watch the debate or the documentary without phones. Selection comparisons indicate that recruited Twitter users are more polarized than recruited non-users. Causal exposure comparisons within the Twitter-user sample show that two strategies often proposed to reduce political polarization on social media, removing access to the platform and exposing users to counter-attitudinal content, do not reduce polarization and may instead produce mild increases. The latter treatment also significantly increases physiological stress (as measured by salivary cortisol). Further exploratory analyses reveal substantial heterogeneity tied to users’ online political environments. Politically segregated individuals — that is, users embedded in echo chambers — exhibit clear backfire effects when access is removed or cross-ideological interactions are encouraged. In particular, both treatments increase polarization among these users. In addition, when cross-ideological interaction is encouraged, segregated users concentrate a larger share of their Twitter engagement within like-minded networks and show higher cortisol levels. By contrast, non-segregated users show little to no response and closely resemble non-users. Moreover, the selection differences observed between recruited Twitter users and non-users in our sample are concentrated among politically segregated users.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在重大政治事件期间，社交媒体访问（Twitter/X）的变化如何影响政治极化和压力，以及这些暴露效应如何与社交媒体选择的更广泛模式相关联。我们在2019年阿根廷总统辩论期间进行了一项预先注册的实验室实验，招募了Twitter用户和非用户。Twitter用户被随机分配到四种条件之一：使用手机正常观看辩论、关闭手机观看辩论、观看辩论的同时与实验者运营的Twitter账户互动（该账户分享平衡的党派内容），或无手机观看政治中立纪录片。非Twitter参与者被随机分配为无手机观看辩论或纪录片。选择比较表明，招募的Twitter用户比招募的非用户更加极化。在Twitter用户样本中的因果暴露比较显示，两种常被提议用于减少社交媒体政治极化的策略——移除平台访问权限和让用户接触对立态度内容——并未减少极化，反而可能产生轻微增加。后一种处理还显著增加了生理压力（通过唾液皮质醇测量）。进一步的探索性分析揭示了与用户在线政治环境相关的显著异质性。政治隔离个体——即处于回音室中的用户——在访问被移除或鼓励跨意识形态互动时表现出明显的反弹效应。特别是，两种处理都增加了这些用户的极化。此外，当鼓励跨意识形态互动时，隔离用户将更大比例的Twitter参与集中在同质网络中，并表现出更高的皮质醇水平。相比之下，非隔离用户几乎没有反应，与非用户高度相似。此外，我们样本中招募的Twitter用户与非用户之间观察到的选择差异主要集中在政治隔离用户中。

title: Sanctions without sanctimony: Why do states impose sanctions?
title_zh: 无道义的制裁：国家为何实施制裁？
title_primary: 无道义的制裁：国家为何实施制裁？
title_secondary: Sanctions without sanctimony: Why do states impose sanctions?
authors: Daniel J. D’Amico, Cameron Tilley, Joshua D. Ammons, Eric H. Wilhelm
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine the political and economic effects of sanctions against their stated goals to justify them. We find null or negative effects on every outcome that we test. Given the ubiquity and persistence of economic sanctions as international policy tools, and given the substantial costs of designing, maintaining, and enforcing sanctions, this seems paradoxical. Why would contemporary nation states impose sanctions with no discernibly beneficial effects? We highlight the behavioral complexity inherent to the context of international relations as a viable explanation for sanctions’ lack of measurable efficacy. Designing and enforcing effective sanctions with precision and accuracy is a tangibly more complex challenge beyond conventional punitive deterrence. Using public choice analysis, we explain how sanctions benefit certain special interests and government authorities. The persistent use of these economic tools for statecraft can ultimately be explained by public choice.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了制裁对其宣称目标的政治与经济效应，以论证其合理性。我们发现，在我们测试的每一项结果上，制裁均呈现无效或负面效应。鉴于经济制裁作为国际政策工具的普遍性与持续性，以及设计、维持和执行制裁所付出的巨大成本，这似乎显得矛盾。为何当代民族国家会实施无明显有益效果的制裁？我们强调国际关系语境中固有的行为复杂性，作为制裁缺乏可衡量效力的合理解释。以精准和精确的方式设计和执行有效制裁，是一项远超传统惩罚性威慑的实际复杂挑战。运用公共选择分析，我们解释了制裁如何惠及特定特殊利益集团和政府当局。这些经济工具在外交中的持续使用，最终可由公共选择理论加以解释。

title: Divestitures and CEO overconfidence
title_zh: 资产剥离与CEO过度自信
title_primary: 资产剥离与CEO过度自信
title_secondary: Divestitures and CEO overconfidence
authors: Mark Humphery-Jenner, Vikram Nanda, Sabatino (Dino) Silveri, Minxing Sun
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Overconfident CEOs overestimate their ability to generate value. We investigate how this affects divestiture activity and whether it moderates a CEO's investment lifecycle. We hypothesize and find that overconfident CEOs are less likely to divest units and their divestment decisions are less sensitive to career lifecycle concerns. In addition, after a divestiture overconfident CEOs spend more on capital expenditures (Capex) and acquisitions than other CEOs. Overall, our results suggest that overconfident CEOs prefer to retain units and divest largely to maintain an investment trajectory. Our results further highlight the important role behavioral traits such as overconfidence play in corporate decision-making.
abstract_zh: 过度自信的首席执行官高估了自己创造价值的能力。我们探讨了这种特质如何影响资产剥离活动，以及它是否调节了CEO的投资生命周期。我们假设并发现，过度自信的CEO不太可能剥离业务单元，且其剥离决策对职业生涯生命周期顾虑的敏感度较低。此外，在资产剥离后，过度自信的CEO在资本支出和收购上的花费高于其他CEO。总体而言，我们的结果表明，过度自信的CEO倾向于保留业务单元，并主要通过剥离来维持投资轨迹。我们的研究进一步强调了过度自信等行为特质在企业决策中的重要作用。

title: Heteregenous Beliefs Recovery
title_zh: 异质性信念的恢复
title_primary: 异质性信念的恢复
title_secondary: Heteregenous Beliefs Recovery
authors: Julien Hugonnier, Darius Nik Nejad, William Parker, Johannes Spinnewijn, Fernanda Ortega 等
official: 官方在线 2025-05-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: we develop an optimization-based method to approximate the implied distribution of consumption shares across beliefs, given discrete time series of prices and interest rates. We confirm the accuracy of this method on simulated data and illustrate the versatility of our approach by providing extensions of our basic recovery theorem that allow for learning and multidimensional beliefs.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于优化的方法，用于在给定价格和利率的离散时间序列的情况下，近似消费份额在信念上的隐含分布。我们通过模拟数据验证了该方法的准确性，并通过提供基本恢复定理的扩展（允许学习和多维信念）展示了我们方法的通用性。

title: DP748 Holes and Loopholes in Integration Agreements: History and Prospects
title_zh: 一体化协议中的漏洞与缺陷：历史与展望
title_primary: 一体化协议中的漏洞与缺陷：历史与展望
title_secondary: DP748 Holes and Loopholes in Integration Agreements: History and Prospects
authors: Michael P Leidy
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: It often appears self-evident that regional integration arrangements (RIAs) result in more far-reaching liberalization of intra-bloc trade than is possible if countries restrict themselves to a multilateral approach. This paper considers whether such arrangements do in fact imply, or facilitate, greater liberalization of trade flows among member countries than that achieved (or sought) in the multilateral (GATT) context. The underlying hypothesis is that the political-economy forces that block far-reaching liberalization in the multilateral context also remain robust and largely decisive in sculpting RIAs. The holes and loopholes - exceptions, sectoral exclusions, market-sharing arrangements and escape clauses of various kinds - embodied in major RIAs are examined to assess the degree to which existing RIAs have achieved liberalization beyond the prevailing multilateral trade policy regime. A number of lessons regarding the likely prevalence of, and scope for, holes and loopholes in alternative types of RIAs are drawn from the historical overview.
abstract_zh: 区域一体化安排（RIAs）往往看似不言而喻地能比各国局限于多边方式时实现更深入的区域内贸易自由化。本文探讨此类安排是否确实意味着或促进了成员国之间比多边（GATT）框架下所实现（或寻求）的更大程度的贸易自由化。其基本假设是：在多边背景下阻碍深度自由化的政治经济力量，在塑造区域一体化安排时同样强劲且具有决定性作用。本文考察了主要区域一体化安排中存在的漏洞与缺口——包括例外条款、部门排除、市场分割安排及各类逃避条款——以评估现有区域一体化安排超越现行多边贸易政策体制所实现的自由化程度。基于历史回顾，本文就不同类型区域一体化安排中漏洞与缺口的可能普遍性及范围得出了若干启示。

title: Critical Peak Rewards: Evidence from a Nationwide Demand Response Program
title_zh: 关键峰值奖励：来自全国需求响应项目的证据
title_primary: 关键峰值奖励：来自全国需求响应项目的证据
title_secondary: Critical Peak Rewards: Evidence from a Nationwide Demand Response Program
authors: Louise Bernard, Robert D. Metcalfe, Andrew Schein
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Demand flexibility at scale is likely to be an important part of the future energy system. This study evaluated the world’s first nationwide domestic and commercial demand flexibility program. We analyzed the policy using a natural field experiment, with a sample of 2.7 million, assigning 119,999 customers to a control group and the rest to receive randomized encouragement to sign up to the demand flexibility program. The program paid consumers to reduce their demand below a predicted baseline at peak demand across 16 events (i.e., when the system was stressed) during the Winter of 2023–24. Customers who opted into events reduced demand during events by 23.1% among compliers, at an average cost for the system operator of £2,325 per MWh. The adoption of solar panels and batteries, heat pumps, and EVs all increased demand response.
abstract_zh: 大规模需求灵活性很可能是未来能源系统的重要组成部分。本研究评估了全球首个全国性居民及商业需求灵活性项目。我们通过自然田野实验对该政策进行分析，样本规模达270万，其中119,999名客户被分配至对照组，其余客户则接受随机激励以注册参与需求灵活性项目。该项目在2023-24年冬季的16个高峰事件（即系统承压时段）中，向消费者支付费用以使其需求低于预测基线水平。在依从者中，选择参与事件的客户在事件期间实现了23.1%的需求削减，系统运营商的平均成本为每兆瓦时2325英镑。太阳能光伏板与电池、热泵及电动汽车的普及均提升了需求响应效果。

title: Inequality and Racial Backlash: Evidence from the Reconstruction Era and the Freedmen’s Bureau
title_zh: 不平等与种族反弹：来自重建时期与自由民局的证据
title_primary: 不平等与种族反弹：来自重建时期与自由民局的证据
title_secondary: Inequality and Racial Backlash: Evidence from the Reconstruction Era and the Freedmen’s Bureau
authors: Eric Chyn, Kareem Haggag, Bryan A. Stuart
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: How do majority groups respond to narrowing inequality in racially polarized environments? We study this by examining the Freedmen’s Bureau, an agency created after the US Civil War to aid former slaves and launch institutional reform in the South. Using new historical records and an event-study approach, we estimate the Bureau’s impact on political, social, and economic outcomes. Vote shares for Democrats, the party that previously championed slavery and opposed Black civil rights, initially eroded in Bureau counties, but these impacts faded as federal oversight weakened. Racial backlash emerged rapidly and persisted, suggesting White majorities sought to offset Black progress.
abstract_zh: 在种族极化环境中，多数群体如何应对日益缩小的不平等？我们通过研究美国内战后为援助前奴隶并在南方推行制度改革而设立的“自由民局”来探讨这一问题。利用新历史记录和事件研究方法，我们估算了该局对政治、社会和经济结果的影响。在自由民局覆盖的县，民主党（此前支持奴隶制并反对黑人公民权利的政党）的得票率最初有所下降，但随着联邦监督的减弱，这些影响逐渐消失。种族反弹迅速出现并持续存在，表明白人多数群体试图抵消黑人的进步。

title: Gambling away stability: Sports betting’s impact on vulnerable households
title_zh: 赌博侵蚀稳定：体育博彩对脆弱家庭的影响
title_primary: 赌博侵蚀稳定：体育博彩对脆弱家庭的影响
title_secondary: Gambling away stability: Sports betting’s impact on vulnerable households
authors: Scott R. Baker, Justin Balthrop, Mark J. Johnson, Jason Kotter, Kevin Pisciotta
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We estimate the causal effect of online sports betting on households’ investment, spending, and debt management decisions using household transaction data and a staggered difference-in-differences framework. Following legalization, sports betting spreads quickly, with both the number of participants and frequency of bets increasing over time. This increase does not displace other gambling or consumption but significantly reduces savings, as risky bets crowd out positive expected value investments. These effects concentrate among frequent bettors and low-savings households. Our findings highlight the potential adverse effects of online sports betting on vulnerable households.
abstract_zh: 我们利用家庭交易数据和交错双重差分框架，估计了在线体育博彩对家庭投资、支出及债务管理决策的因果效应。合法化后，体育博彩迅速普及，参与人数和投注频率均随时间增加。这一增长并未挤占其他赌博或消费活动，但显著减少了储蓄，因为高风险投注排挤了具有正期望值的投资。这些影响集中在频繁投注者和低储蓄家庭中。我们的研究结果凸显了在线体育博彩对弱势家庭可能产生的不利影响。

title: Do Taxpayer Assistance Programs Improve Compliance among Small Firms? Evidence from Brazil
title_zh: 纳税人援助计划是否改善了小型企业的合规性？来自巴西的证据
title_primary: 纳税人援助计划是否改善了小型企业的合规性？来自巴西的证据
title_secondary: Do Taxpayer Assistance Programs Improve Compliance among Small Firms? Evidence from Brazil
authors: Simone Covre, Paulo Henrique Muller Prado, Enlinson Mattos
official: 来源期次 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the effects of taxpayer assistance on corporate tax compliance using administrative data from Brazil’s simplified tax regime (Simples Nacional). Exploiting two large-scale assistance campaigns implemented at different points in time, we adopt a difference-in-differences design, using firms treated later as a control group. We find that assistance generates a large and statistically significant short-run increase in reported tax liabilities: reported amounts rise by 41 percent on average, with peak effects exceeding 270 percent within three months, driven by adjustment tax liabilities. However, these effects are temporary and dissipate within fifteen months. Firms exposed to repeated interventions respond more strongly, suggesting reinforcement effects.
abstract_zh: 本文利用巴西简化税收制度（Simples Nacional）的行政数据，考察纳税人援助对企业税收合规的影响。借助在不同时间点实施的两轮大规模援助活动，我们采用双重差分设计，将后期接受处理的企业作为对照组。研究发现，援助在短期内显著提高了企业申报的税收负债：平均申报金额上升41%，峰值效应在三个月内超过270%，且主要由调整性税收负债驱动。然而，这些效应是暂时的，并在十五个月内逐渐消退。接受多次干预的企业反应更为强烈，表明存在强化效应。

title: No Place Like Home? The Causal Effect of Forced Relocation from Central Addis Ababa
title_zh: 行动中的区域一体化发展
title_primary: 行动中的区域一体化发展
title_secondary: No Place Like Home? The Causal Effect of Forced Relocation from Central Addis Ababa
authors: Bryan, Gharad, Franklin, Simon, Getahun, Tigabu, Winton, Sarah
official: 官方在线 2026-06-21 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Do central slums provide essential economic and social benefits to the poor? We collected bespoke data for 5,000 households to study mass forced clearances in Addis Ababa. Evictees were offered alternative subsidized housing further from the center. Exploiting sharp clearance zone boundaries, regression-discontinuity estimates show negative impacts on social networks, but positive impacts on work, earnings, housing quality and environmental amenity. Relocating households close to their ex-ante neighbors eliminates social costs. Slums are not essential: relocation policies can be designed to fully compensate residents, and the sale value of cleared land more than covers the cost.
abstract_zh: 准确的股票价格预测一直是支撑量化交易与投资决策的关键且具有挑战性的金融科技任务。近期研究致力于建模股票市场中各类复杂关系，以实现更可靠的股价预测。这些方法高度依赖强静态先验假设，要么基于预定义结构建模单只股票的时间依赖性，要么建模不同股票间的空间依赖性，但驱动股价波动的复杂市场动态仍未被探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的博弈论建模方法，通过捕捉异质投资者互动来实现股价预测。核心思想是将博弈论机制嵌入异质图结构，精细建模目标股票相关异质投资者间的动态策略互动。此外，采用时间位置编码来反映时间窗口内不同时间步的每个博弈事件对未来股价波动的差异化影响。借助异质图网络，我们通过投资者博弈代理股票市场的复杂动态，实现所有节点间的实时信息传播与节点更新。在两个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法有效超越了现有最先进的股价预测方法。

title: The Debt‐Equity Spread
title_zh: 债务-权益利差
title_primary: 债务-权益利差
title_secondary: The Debt‐Equity Spread
authors: HUI CHEN, ZHIYAO CHEN, JUN LI
official: 官方在线 2026-06-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a measure of the valuation gap between debt and equity—debt‐equity spread (DES)—based on the difference between actual and equity‐implied credit spreads. DES predicts cross‐sectional stock and bond returns in opposite directions. This predictability is unique compared to existing mispricing measures and cannot be explained by exposures to various risk factors. High‐DES firms are more likely to issue equity and retire debt, and have more insider equity selling. These findings are consistent with DES capturing relative mispricing between debt and equity, and provide empirical support for the model of partially segmented markets in Greenwood, Hanson, and Liao (2018, Review of Financial Studies 31, 3307–3343).
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种衡量债务与股权估值差距的指标——债务-股权利差（DES），该指标基于实际信用利差与股权隐含信用利差之间的差异。DES能够反向预测股票和债券的横截面收益。这种预测能力相较于现有的错误定价指标具有独特性，且无法通过各类风险因子的暴露来解释。高DES企业更倾向于发行股票并偿还债务，同时内部人股权出售行为更为频繁。这些发现与DES捕捉债务与股权相对错误定价的结论一致，并为Greenwood、Hanson和Liao（2018，《金融研究评论》第31卷，第3307–3343页）提出的部分分割市场模型提供了实证支持。

title: The role of specialized knowledge and ‘know-how’ for firm productivity: Evidence from the equine sector
title_zh: 专业知识与“诀窍”对企业生产率的作用：来自马业部门的证据
title_primary: 专业知识与“诀窍”对企业生产率的作用：来自马业部门的证据
title_secondary: The role of specialized knowledge and ‘know-how’ for firm productivity: Evidence from the equine sector
authors: Pia Nilsson, Hans Andersson, Tobias Heldt
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using matched employer–employee data, we examine how workforce knowledge characteristics relate to firm productivity in the equine sector. Using panel data on Swedish equine firms from 2010 to 2022, we construct measures of workforce composition, including occupation-specific education, accumulated work experience and knowledge diversity. The results show that access to occupation-specific human capital is positively associated with productivity, with substantial heterogeneity across firms. Knowledge effects are stronger among firms specializing in horse racing than in breeding, highlighting differences in the role of human capital across production orientations. The findings have implications for policy and firms’ investment decisions.
abstract_zh: 利用匹配的雇主-雇员数据，我们研究了马业部门劳动力知识特征与企业生产率之间的关系。基于2010年至2022年瑞典马业企业的面板数据，我们构建了劳动力构成指标，包括职业特定教育、累积工作经验及知识多样性。结果表明，职业特定人力资本的获取与生产率呈正相关，且企业间存在显著异质性。相较于育种企业，赛马专营企业的知识效应更为显著，凸显了人力资本在不同生产导向中的差异化作用。该发现对政策制定及企业投资决策具有启示意义。

title: Job Transitions and Employee Earnings after Acquisitions: Linking Corporate and Worker Outcomes
title_zh: 收购后的职位转换与员工收入：企业绩效与员工结果的关联
title_primary: 收购后的职位转换与员工收入：企业绩效与员工结果的关联
title_secondary: Job Transitions and Employee Earnings after Acquisitions: Linking Corporate and Worker Outcomes
authors: David Arnold, Kevin Milligan, Terry S. Moon, Amirhossein Tavakoli
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper connects changes in employer characteristics through job transitions to employee earnings following mergers and acquisitions. Using firm balance sheet data linked to individual earnings data in Canada and a matched difference-in-differences design, we find that earnings of workers at target firms decrease after M&As relative to control workers, largely driven by those who move to other firms. Workers leaving targets move to larger and more profitable firms, but still experience wage declines. These decreased earnings are also concentrated among workers with longer tenure. These results are consistent with workers losing valuable match-specific premia after M&A-induced job transitions.
abstract_zh: 本文通过工作转换将雇主特征的变化与并购后员工收入联系起来。利用加拿大企业资产负债表数据与个人收入数据的关联，并采用匹配双重差分法，我们发现目标企业员工在并购后的收入相对于对照组员工有所下降，这主要源于那些跳槽至其他企业的员工。离开目标企业的员工虽转向规模更大、盈利能力更强的公司，但仍经历工资下降。这些收入下降现象还集中在任职时间较长的员工群体中。研究结果与员工在并购引发的职业转换中失去有价值的岗位特定溢价这一解释相一致。

title: Winners and Losers from the Protestant Reformation: An Analysis of the Network of European Universities
title_zh: 宗教改革的赢家与输家：欧洲大学网络分析
title_primary: 宗教改革的赢家与输家：欧洲大学网络分析
title_secondary: Winners and Losers from the Protestant Reformation: An Analysis of the Network of European Universities
authors: de la Croix, David, Morault, Pauline
official: 官方在线 2026-04-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using a new database of European academics, we build a network of universities that is based on professors’ mobility. We describe how the network was altered following the Protestant Reformation. We focus on fragmentation and on universities’ centrality. Dyadic regressions confirm that geography and vernacular languages were important for mobility, but did not substitute for religion. We compare simulated networks with and without religious identity. Most universities lose centrality in the simulated religious network compared to the non-religious one. As publications per university are correlated with centrality, the loss of connectedness of many universities after the Reformation contributed to their scientific decline.
abstract_zh: 基于欧洲学者新数据库，我们构建了以教授流动为基础的大学网络，并描述了宗教改革后该网络的变化。研究聚焦于网络碎片化与大学中心性。二元回归分析证实，地理因素与地方语言对学者流动具有重要影响，但并未取代宗教的作用。通过对比含宗教身份与不含宗教身份的模拟网络，发现多数大学在含宗教身份的模拟网络中中心性低于不含宗教身份的网络。由于大学论文发表数量与中心性相关，宗教改革后众多大学连通性的下降导致了其科学地位的衰落。

title: Impartial observer theorem with ambiguity
title_zh: 含模糊性的公正观察者定理
title_primary: 含模糊性的公正观察者定理
title_secondary: Impartial observer theorem with ambiguity
authors: Raphael Gomes de Oliveira
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper revisits the debate between Harsanyi and Rawls on collective decision-making with impartiality (Veil of Ignorance), focusing on how different levels of uncertainty influence the resulting social welfare functions. By incorporating ambiguity into the Impartial Observer framework, the paper constructs a continuum of compromise positions between Harsanyi’s utilitarian approach and Rawls’s maximin rule. In the proposed model, the independence between the uncertainty faced by the Impartial Observer over the distributions of identities and the uncertainty faced by each individual over the distributions of outcomes allows us to introduce ambiguity on both identity acts and/or outcome acts to explore various configurations where the Impartial Observer’s preference representation changes based on the type and level of uncertainty considered. The results offer a more nuanced understanding of impartiality in social choice contexts and help clarify the philosophical foundations of the Harsanyi–Rawls debate.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了哈萨尼与罗尔斯关于公正集体决策（无知之幕）的辩论，聚焦于不同程度的不确定性如何影响由此产生的社会福利函数。通过将模糊性纳入公正观察者框架，本文构建了介于哈萨尼功利主义方法与罗尔斯最大最小规则之间的连续折中立场。在所提出的模型中，公正观察者面临的身份分布不确定性与每个个体面临的结果分布不确定性之间的独立性，使我们得以在身份行为及/或结果行为上引入模糊性，以探索各种配置，其中公正观察者的偏好表示随所考虑的不确定性的类型和水平而变化。研究结果增进了对社会选择情境中公正性的细致理解，并有助于澄清哈萨尼-罗尔斯辩论的哲学基础。

title: How does digital transformation affect cross-boundary innovation? Evidence from China
title_zh: 数字化转型如何影响跨界创新？——来自中国的证据
title_primary: 数字化转型如何影响跨界创新？——来自中国的证据
title_secondary: How does digital transformation affect cross-boundary innovation? Evidence from China
authors: Xiaobin Feng, Dongju Zhao, Xiaoshu Ma, Jie Lei
official: 官方在线 2025-07-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Despite the growing importance of digital transformation (DT) in reshaping organizational innovation, its role in fostering cross-boundary innovation remains underexplored. Using an approach that is grounded in resource dependence theory (RDT), this study examines the impact of DT on cross-boundary innovation by analysing a sample of 2,582 Chinese A-share listed companies from 2012 to 2022. The findings indicate that DT significantly enhances enterprises’ cross-boundary innovation and promotes incremental and breakthrough innovation. Furthermore, mechanism analyses reveal that DT facilitates cross-boundary innovation by expanding innovation networks and reducing external transaction costs. Additionally, heterogeneity analysis reveals that high-tech enterprises and those with strong absorptive capacity are more likely to benefit from DT in fostering cross-boundary innovation. This research contributes to the literature by providing empirical evidence on the mechanisms by which DT enhances cross-boundary innovation, thus deepening the understanding of such mechanisms through the lens of RDT. Practically, this study offers guidance for enterprises to leverage DT in optimizing networks and reducing transaction costs, thereby achieving breakthroughs and incremental innovations across boundaries.
abstract_zh: 尽管数字化转型（DT）在重塑组织创新中的重要性日益凸显，但其在促进跨界创新方面的作用仍未得到充分探索。本研究基于资源依赖理论（RDT），通过分析2012年至2022年间2,582家中国A股上市公司的样本，考察了DT对跨界创新的影响。研究发现，DT显著增强了企业的跨界创新，并促进了渐进式创新与突破式创新。此外，机制分析表明，DT通过扩大创新网络和降低外部交易成本来促进跨界创新。进一步地，异质性分析揭示，高科技企业和具有较强吸收能力的企业更有可能从DT中受益，以促进跨界创新。本研究通过提供DT增强跨界创新机制的实证证据，为相关文献做出贡献，从而通过RDT视角加深对这些机制的理解。实践上，本研究为企业利用DT优化网络、降低交易成本，从而实现跨界突破与渐进创新提供了指导。
